title: CMS-only hosts should serve the newsroom at / (newsroom.pilobol.us/newsroom is redundant)
description: Ryan: why would we duplicate "newsroom" in newsroom.pilobol.us/newsroom? On a CMS-only host (Pilobol.us CMS app: Markus site, the host is only the editing UI) the newsroom should live at / . Papyrus supports brand.rootRoute {kind:"newsroom"} + newsroomBasePath "" (middleware.ts line ~17, lib/newsroom-base-path.ts, app/page.tsx; /newsroom redirects to /), but docs/standard-site.md says no browser sign-in flow was tested in that mode. Verify and fix every place that assumes /newsroom: staging gate redirect target (middleware.ts redirects anonymous staging requests to /newsroom), Cognito/Amplify OAuth return path (redirectUrls with /newsroom and /), sign-in/sign-out redirects, links, newsroomHref/getNewsroomNavHref, the Preview/staging flow, robots/noindex, bookmarks (/newsroom/* -> /*). Then switch the Pilobol.us scaffold brand to newsroomBasePath "" + rootRoute newsroom (PR into Pilobol.us main). Pretext sites that own / (Threat Intelligence, p.apyr.us) keep /newsroom: no change for them.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Papyrus PRs #157 and #158 merged (released 1.0.0-next.24): staging never gates a root-mounted newsroom, public-path helpers used for hrefs/history/redirects, /newsroom -> / keeps OAuth code/state, tests test:newsroom-root-paths and test:newsroom-root-middleware. Pilobol.us switch PR open (not merged). Needs Ryan browser sign-in at newsroom.pilobol.us/ after merge.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Bug: signed-out / hung on the access gate. Cause: app/page.tsx rendered the newsroom at / outside app/newsroom/layout.tsx, so NewsDeskClientProvider was absent and the gate stayed on checkingAccess with no Cognito or AppSync requests. Fix: NewsroomClientShell shared by the /newsroom layout and the root page (Papyrus#162, released 1.0.0-next.28); regression test test:newsroom-root-provider (structural, no jsdom or browser infra in repo). Verified in headless Chrome vs next dev (pilobol-us brand, dev seed sign-in off): /, /articles, /references, /newsroom, /newsroom/articles, /?code=a&state=b all reach signedOut; sign-in click goes to the Cognito hosted UI authorize URL. Not verified: real Google login, OAuth code exchange, production build, deployed site. Pilobol.us pin PR open, not merged.

right_now_summary: Papyrus fixes are released; the Pilobol.us switch awaits merge and browser sign-in verification.
